items.text: The final episode of Friends aired on NBC on May 6, 2004.
items.question: Where were you when you watched the last episode of Friends, and who was on the couch with you?
items.source_quote: May 6 – The final episode of Friends airs on NBC, drawing an estimated 66 million viewers in North America.

items.text: On October 27, 2004, the Boston Red Sox defeated the St. Louis Cardinals in four games to win the World Series for the first time since 1918.
items.question: Where were you when the Red Sox won the 2004 World Series, and who did you call or celebrate with?
items.source_quote: October 27 – The Boston Red Sox defeat the St. Louis Cardinals in four games to win the World Series for the first time since 1918, breaking the Curse of the Bambino.

items.text: Usher's "Yeah!" was the longest-running number-one single of 2004 on the Billboard Hot 100, staying on top for 12 straight weeks.
items.question: Where were you living when Usher's "Yeah!" was playing everywhere, and who in your life was always turning it up?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles of the United States.
Usher's "Yeah!" is the longest-running number-one single of 2004, remaining in that position for 12 straight weeks.

items.text: On February 4, 2004, Mark Zuckerberg launched "TheFacebook", later renamed Facebook, as a social networking website for Harvard University students.
items.question: Do you remember when you first joined Facebook, and who was your first friend on it?
items.source_quote: February 4 – Mark Zuckerberg launches "TheFacebook", later renamed to Facebook, a social networking website for Harvard University students.
